text:
```yaml
name: Claude Code Review

on:
  pull_request:
    branches:
      - main

jobs:
  review:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v2

      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v2
        with:
          node-version: '14'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm install

      - name: Run Claude Code Review
        uses: anthropics/claude-code-action@v1
        with:
          prompt: |
            Please review the code changes in this pull request and provide feedback on more consistent code comments and documentation. Specifically, ensure that extended @file documentation is restored across popup helpers, entry points, models, search strategies, and views to match legacy details. Highlight the scoring pipeline steps so future tuning keeps parity with historical behavior notes.
          allowed_bots: []
          allowed_non_write_users: []

      - name: Comment on Pull Request
        uses: thollander/actions-comment-pull-request@e4a76dd2b0a3c2027c3fd84147a67c22ee4c90fa
        with:
          message: "Code review completed by Claude. Please address any feedback."
          pr-number: ${{ github.event.pull_request.number }}
          github-token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
```
